sentences.text: Dhoom 3 -LRB- -LSB- - hnsˈd̪ʱuːm 3 -RSB- , English : Blast 3 or Boom 3 , also abbreviated and known as D :3 and D3 -RRB- is a 2013 Indian action thriller film written and directed by Vijay Krishna Acharya and produced by Aditya Chopra .	Vijay Krishna Acharya	Vijay Krishna Acharya	Aditya Chopra	Aditya Chopra	action thriller	action thriller

The third installment of the Dhoom series , it features Aamir Khan as the antagonist and Katrina Kaif , with Abhishek Bachchan in the lead role reprising his role of ACP Jai Dixit and Uday Chopra reprising his role as Ali Akbar , as in the previous films of the franchise .	Aamir Khan	Aamir Khan	Abhishek Bachchan	Abhishek Bachchan	Katrina Kaif	Katrina Kaif	Uday Chopra	Uday Chopra	antagonist	antagonist
Made on a budget of , it was the most expensive Indian film , until it was beaten by Baahubali : The Beginning .	Indian film	Indian film

Dhoom 3 was released on 20 December 2013 , marking itself as the first Indian film to be released in the IMAX motion picture film format with Dolby Atmos surround sound .	Indian film	Indian film	IMAX	IMAX	film format	film format	Dolby Atmos	Dolby Atmos

The film went on to gross worldwide in just ten days , to become the highest-grossing Bollywood film of all time in international markets at the time and as of May 2017 is the sixth highest-grossing Indian film of all time .	Indian film	Indian film	highest-grossing Bollywood film of all time	List of highest-grossing Bollywood films	sixth highest-grossing Indian film of all time	List of highest-grossing Indian films
It was the 77th highest grossing film of 2013 worldwide .

The film was screened during the 2014 International Film Festival of India in the Celebrating Dance in Indian cinema section .	International Film Festival of India	International Film Festival of India
